source_observation: Subsection 3 states that an authorized emergency vehicle must have at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front and a siren, with both complying with standards approved by the Department of Public Safety. It separately permits other red or blue warning lights. Subsection 6 lists official vehicles of regulatory agencies among exceptions to the front-visible red-light restriction. The assignment invokes subsection 3's flashing-light requirements for the official-vehicle alternative; the exact application to that alternative and the agency's vehicle authority remain review questions.
